description: SwiftUI extension adding a view for managing cron job settings, including UI components such as header, content, scheduler banner, and detail views with actions for editing, deleting, and refreshing cron jobs.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main SwiftUI View structure, including the layout and interactions for cron job management.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a warning banner if the cron scheduler is disabled, with information and store path.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header part of the UI, including refresh and new job buttons.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Creates the main content area with a list of jobs and a detail view of the selected job.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays details and run history of the selected cron job or a placeholder message.
